$description:
Copy of the plain brand to adjust on the vk/adjustments branch. A second theme proves the tokens are actually load-bearing rather than
decorative. Same structure, different voice.
The dark appearance (added 2026-10-31, ADR-043) lets guided prototypes show a product meant for dark rooms before any brand theme exists: the same grays and blue, inverted.
name: vk-plain
